FILED s526w2 (Opus, 2026-10-24) from YAML-PP 53.customtag-alias.t (`%$$data = (%$$data, %$item)`, inherit-tag).  SILENT WRONG, PRE-EXISTING (base /home/bernt/pcl at 706cfde8 prints b).

    my $r={a=>1}; %$r = (%$r, b=>2); print join(",",sort keys %$r),"\n";   # perl a,b   PCL b
    my $ar=[1]; my $ad=\$ar; @$$ad = (@$$ad, 2); print "@$ar\n";            # perl 1 2   PCL 2
    my $q={a=>1}; my %t=%$q; %$q = (%t, b=>2);                              # right (no self-reference)

Emission: (p-hash-deref-= (p-cast-% $r) (vector (p-cast-% $r :rvalue) "b" 2)) -- the vector holds the hash ITSELF, and p-hash-deref-= (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp ~31437) does (clrhash h) BEFORE (%p-flatten-list value); p-array-deref-= the same with (setf (fill-pointer arr) 0).  Fix shape: flatten VALUE first, then clear and fill (perl copies the RHS list before the aggregate assignment).  Check the tied arms (%p-th-fill / %p-ta-fill) and p-hash-fill for the same order.  Everyday-shaped (merging defaults into a hashref: `%$opts = (%defaults, %$opts)` is fine, `%$self = (%$self, @_)` is not).

subject: SILENT WRONG: `%$r = (%$r, k => v)` and `@$r = (@$r, x)` through a REFERENCE clear the target BEFORE the right side is read -- `my $r={a=>1}; %$r=(%$r,b=>2)` leaves only b (perl a,b); `%h = (%h, ...)` on a named hash is right
